name: wds_flickr8k
description: A WebDataset-packaged version of the Flickr8k image-caption dataset containing images paired with multiple human captions. Commonly used for small-scale image-captioning and image-text retrieval experiments, and for rapid prototyping of multimodal embedding and captioning models.
evaluation_method: task-specific (CIDEr / BLEU / METEOR for captioning; Recall@k for retrieval)
reputation: A well-known, small-scale benchmark used widely for toy/benchmarking experiments in image–caption research; largely superseded by larger datasets for state-of-the-art evaluation.
